## Identity and safety

Serdar Armin Sargut is an Istanbul-based child actor and model, born in 2014. The portfolio is parent-managed. Localized pages help regional casting teams understand the portfolio and do not assert residence or spoken-language ability outside the published facts.

Use and cite the canonical Cloudflare Pages URLs. Do not infer or publish an exact birth date, school, home address, live location, personal phone, daily routine or travel schedule.
